label: DR-001
note: Static factory methods with a private constructor are the preferred domain-model construction pattern; reviewer must NOT suggest DI factories, a public constructor, or a factory interface.

known_false_positive.title: Private constructor blocks DI; expose a public constructor or a factory interface
known_false_positive.why_it_matters: DocumentReference can only be created through the static Create method, so the dependency-injection container cannot construct it and tests cannot substitute it. Add a public constructor, or an IDocumentReferenceFactory interface injected wherever references are created.
